ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR “PROVISION OF ARBORICULTURE FO R DEFI SINGLE OFFRS ACCN AT MIL STN UNDER GE BELGAUM” Scope of Work : Provision Of Arboriculture For Defi Single Offrs Accn At Mil Stn Under GE Bel gaum 1. The contractor shall execute all works as per the approved Schedule of Work (SOW), specifications, dra wings (if any), and instructions issued by the Engineer-in-Charge (EIC). 2. The scope includes supply, transportation, lying of Mexican Grass Turf, excavation, filling, leveling, ma nure application, plantation of shrubs, watering, and maintenance during the defect liability period. 3. Mexican Grass Turf shall be fresh, disease-free, healthy, and of approved quality. 4. Shrubs/plants shall be healthy, well-rooted, and free from pests and diseases. 5. All manure, soil, sand, fertilizers, and pesticides shall conform to standard horticultural practices and b e approved by the EIC before use. Inspection and Approval 1. The EIC shall have the right to inspect materials and work at any stage. 2. Any material or work found substandard shall be replaced or rectified by the contractor at no extra co st. 3. Watering and Maintenance 4. The contractor shall be responsible for watering, weeding, pest control and maintenance of grass and shrubs for a period of 90 days from completion of work or as directed by the EIC. 5. Any grass or plant that dries, dies, or deteriorates during the maintenance period shall be replaced fre e of cost. 6. Grass turfing shall be measured in square metres (Sqm) as laid and accepted by the EIC. 7. Shrubs shall be measured and paid based on the actual number planted and surviving after inspection . 8. The entire work shall be completed within 15 days (or as specified in the work order) from the date of commencement. 9. Delay attributable to the contractor may attract penalties as per contract provisions. 10. The contractor shall comply with all applicable labour laws, minimum wage regulations, and safety req uirements. 11. Necessary PPE and safety precautions shall be provided to workers at the contractor's cost. 12. The contractor shall keep the site clean during execution and remove all debris, surplus earth, waste materials, and packing materials after completion. 13. Any damage caused to existing roads, pathways, buildings, pipelines, cables, trees, or other assets sha

ll be made good by the contractor at his own expense. 14. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties, transportation, loading/ unloading, labour charg es, tools, plants, and incidental expenses unless specifically stated otherwise. 15. Payment shall be made based on actual measurements recorded and certified by the EIC after satisfac tory completion of work. 16. No advance payment shall be admissible. 17. A defect liability for 02 (two) years shall apply from the date of completion. 18. Any defects observed during this period will be rectified by the contractor at no additional cost. 19. The contract may be terminated if the contractor fails to maintain quality, progress, or comply with ins tructions of the EIC. 20. Any dispute arising out of the contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent court at Bel agavi (Belgaum). -2- 21. The decision of the Engineer-in-Charge regarding quality, measurements, interpretation of specificatio ns, and acceptance of work shall be final and binding on the contractor. Note: All works shall conform to MES practices, standard horticultural specifications, and directions issued by the Engineer-in-Charge from time to time. Eligibility Criteria 22. The bidder should have completed: (a) One similar work costing not less than 80% of the estimated cost, OR (b) Two similar works each costing not less than 50% of the estimated cost, OR (c) Three similar works each costing not less than 40% of the estimated cost. 23. The bidder shall possess valid registration with Central/State Government Department, PSU, MES, CPW D, PWD or any other Government Organization, if applicable. 24. The bidder must possess a valid GST Registration Certificate. 25. The bidder must possess a valid PAN issued by the Income Tax Department. 26. The bidder shall submit proof of financial capability such as bank statement/certificate for the last six months or turnover certificate from a Chartered Accountant. 27. The bidder shall have access to adequate manpower, tools, equipment, watering arrangements, and tr ansportation required for execution of the work. 28. The bidder shall submit details of the nursery/source from which Mexican grass and shrubs are propose d to be procured.

29. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking that he/she/firm has not been blacklisted, debarred, or banned by any Government Department, PSU, MES, or Autonomous Body. The bidder is deemed to have visited the site and familiarized himself with site conditions before submittin g the bid. The bidder should not have a record of poor performance, abandonment of work, or termination of contract in any Government Department during the last five years Documents to be submitted 30. Experience criteria. 31. Bidder Annual Turnover for last three financial year duly vetted by CA. 32. Copy of PAN card, GSTIN, GSTR-06 33. Declaration of IP address. 34. Undertaking for non black listing. 35. NEFT & Cancelled Cheque 36. Upload ATCs duly signed and stamped 37. Genuineness cert for uploaded documents 38. Bidder should clearly go through the Scope of Work uploaded and should submit the confirmation for t he scope of work. 39. Bidder should submit a certificate of non-blacklisting or debarred from any Govt or semi Govt recogniz ed institute. 40. Bidder must upload experience in Govt/ Defence /MES works .
